macro_mechanisms.description: Same DictionaryItem & derivational chain; pure suffix homophony (-I, -In, -lArI)
Same DictionaryItem; different IG count or derived POS (Participle/Infinitive/Zero)
Different DictionaryItems, same lemma & stem, different POS (Adj/Noun, Det/Pron, Adv/Noun)
Stem-boundary split with identical final IG (belir+Caus vs belirt) — F15/F17 blind
Stem-boundary split with different final IGs (koy+un vs koyun, yaş+a+ma vs yaşa+ma)
Same-length homonymous roots or phonological alternations across different POS (yüz, var, bin)
Circumflex twins (kar/kâr), CompoundP3sg twins (zeytinyağı), or vowel-drop twins
Multi-locus ambiguity combining root/POS collision and inflectional/derivational syncretism
